rows.label: tlk41200123_05_msg0001
rows.name:
You know, my teacher is
worried about something.

rows.label: tlk41200123_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Apparently, getting along with the
Blade hasn't been easy.

rows.label: tlk41200123_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Apparently, once you've gone as far
as you can, working and fighting
together hardly deepens the bond.

rows.label: tlk41200123_05_msg0004
rows.name:
But I don't think that's true. I think
if you fight, and fight, and fight it
out, you'll see a whole new world.

rows.label: tlk41200123_05_msg0005
rows.name:
An ordinary Driver might not be
able to reach that point, but...

rows.label: tlk41200123_05_msg0006
rows.name:
If you could become that close...
that would be the best!
